title: Extract and account for SRD stat blocks document-wide
description:
Problem

The importer appears to find monster appendix creatures but misses stat-block-shaped content elsewhere in the SRD. The latest audit identified at least:

- Avatar of Death, embedded in Deck of Many Things on p. 218.
- Giant Fly, embedded in Figurine of Wondrous Power on p. 222.

These are source stat blocks and should not be silently flattened into magic-item descriptions without structured representation.

Task

Make stat-block extraction document-wide and account for embedded stat blocks.

Implementation guidance

- Detect stat-block-shaped content across the full SRD, not only the monster/NPC appendix.
- Decide and document whether embedded stat blocks are emitted as normal creature records, emitted as a distinct embedded-stat-block kind, or stored as structured child data on the containing record.
- Whatever model is chosen, the coverage gate must account for the source stat block.
- Preserve source provenance linking embedded stat blocks to both their own source span and containing source item when applicable.
- Do not duplicate content in uncontrolled prose and structured records without clear ownership.

Regression cases

Add tests proving that the source inventory detects and accounts for:

- Avatar of Death,
- Giant Fly,
- at least one ordinary monster appendix creature,
- at least one NPC stat block if NPCs remain a separate kind.

Acceptance criteria

- Stat-block detection runs over the whole SRD.
- Embedded stat blocks are represented or intentionally accounted for.
- Avatar of Death and Giant Fly no longer disappear as unstructured magic-item prose.
- Existing creature and NPC record ids remain stable unless a documented schema decision requires otherwise.
notes: Review fix pushed (6772233): stat-block records now preserve full keyed fields (damage/condition immunities, senses, languages, challenge+XP incl '—'). Wrapped values (Avatar Condition Immunities/Senses) recovered from containing item's reflowed description via cleanTextByName; Giant Fly via single-line raw. Traits/actions (Avatar Reaping Scythe) still in prose — 4a7.8 must not strip inline prose until those are structured.
close_reason: Merged to main via PR #199 (squash 7ec61cd). New stat-block kind emits Avatar of Death + Giant Fly with full keyed fields, container statBlockRefs, and inline-source provenance; source-coverage flips to record:stat-block:*. Figurine->Giant Fly ref + Avatar traits/actions capture tracked on eshyra-4a7.8.
